advanced.startHiddenTip: Open to the menu bar without showing this window. Needs the menu bar icon.
advanced.launchOnStartupTip: Start Audible automatically when you log in.
advanced.showMenuBarIconTip: Show Audible in the menu bar. When hidden, reopen Audible from Launchpad or Finder.
advanced.removeFillerWordsTip: Removes fillers like “um”, “uh”, “ờ”, “ừm” and repeated stutters. Done on this Mac.
advanced.interfaceLanguageTip: Changes the app's text only. Speech is always detected automatically as English or Vietnamese.
advanced.cleanAndReformatTip: After transcription, Groq removes fillers and false starts and formats the text for the app you're in. Sends the transcript, your dictionary, and the frontmost app name and window title to Groq. Needs a Groq API key.
advanced.groqApiKeyTip: Stored in the macOS Keychain, never in Audible's settings file. Get a key at console.groq.com.
advanced.keySaveFailed: Couldn't save the key to the Keychain.
advanced.keyRemoveFailed: Couldn't remove the key from the Keychain.
